deviations.claim_in_article: Yet about 37% of hot-desk workers said their seating had become fixed anyway.
deviations.issue: A-06 reports that 36.8% of free-address respondents said seating tends to become fixed. “Had become fixed” presents this tendency as an already completed condition, slightly strengthening the certainty of the finding.
deviations.explanation: The percentage is appropriately rounded, but the wording shifts from a reported tendency to a completed state. This sentence is not treated as a Hook.
